A '''turbine generator''' was a massive [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. Alongside banks of [[Capacitor/Legends|capacitors]], the turbine generator built up and stored the energy necessary to power and fire a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]].<ref name="SWS" /> At least two powered each individual turbolaser tower aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> Turbine generators were also used to power ship-based [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] such as the [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel]] [[NK-7 ion cannon/Legends|NK-7 ion cannon]].<ref name="EGWT" />
